name: Rows
title: rows.com
shortDescription: Rows transforms the traditional spreadsheet experience into a powerful tool for building applications without coding. It's designed for business professionals who wish to leverage their spreadsheet skills to create, share, and manage tools with rich data and intuitive interfaces. An example use case is a marketing team using Rows to develop custom reporting tools that integrate seamlessly with their existing data sources.
pros: No coding required to build apps
cons: May not replace complex coding for advanced needs
Potential learning curve for advanced features
